notes: Page title 'Greasy Burgers', subtitle '"We all need to make time for burger once in a while ( All the burgers are served with chips )"'. Junktion77 logo top right. Orange/mustard background with gear pattern; dark brown decorative serif headings, dark green bold serif item names, white descriptions; green dot = veg, red dot = non-veg. Sub-sections 'Fusion Burgers' (subtitle 'Burgers turned crazy to add charm to your plate') and 'GG Special' (singular, as printed). Bottom: photo of crumb-fried stuffed burger cut open with melted cheese and grilled peppers. No nutrition table, no tax info. Fully legible. Pizza Burger has no veg dot and two prices (Veg 180 / Non Veg 200). Spellings kept as printed ('Pouched', 'Cripsy', 'letttuce', 'descibe').
